French presidential candidate Jean-Luc Mélenchon, founder of La France Insoumise, has published his program for the April 2027 election and presented it at a rally in Le Bourget, near Paris, attended by nearly 20,000 people according to his party. "We have no business being in NATO or in American wars," he told the crowd.

➡️NATO: Immediate exit from the integrated military command, followed by step-by-step withdrawal from the alliance, and rejection of the 5% of GDP defense target demanded by Washington.

➡️Palestine: Effective Palestinian sovereignty over all territories occupied since 1967, while leaving open an "egalitarian binational state."

➡️Pensions: Retirement age back from 64 to 62, then a full pension at 60 after 40 years of contributions.

➡️Youth: A mandatory nine-month ecological service for under-25s, paid at the minimum wage, mainly to help society adapt to climate crises.

➡️Cost of living: Full healthcare coverage through social security and a price freeze on some essential goods.

➡️Energy: A gradual exit from nuclear power and 100% renewables by 2060 at the latest.

“Blessed is he who blesses you,

Until He comes, let’s be about His business, making the most of every opportunity because the days are evil. Let’s not grow weary in doing good! (Luke 19:13; Ephesians 5:15–16; Galatians 6:9)

“For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind.”
(2 Timothy 1:7)
